figurative_meaning_bn: অল্পবিস্তর, উপর-উপর, একটু-আধটু, কিছুকিছু, যৎসামান্য, সীমাবদ্ধ
figurative_meaning_en: superficial, approximate, a little bit, somewhat, limited or scant
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ইংরেজি ভাষার জ্ঞান ভাসাভাসা, গভীর নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: My knowledge on this topic is superficial.
His understanding of English is just a smattering, not deep.
note: This idiom is widely used in spoken Bengali to describe vague or incomplete familiarity with a subject.
